split_method: Original source test retained. Exact and near-duplicate components defined before splits using unlabeled normalized text and char TF-IDF cosine >=0.95; exclude train components touching test; remove conflicting exact-label training groups; deduplicate exact training groups; StratifiedGroupKFold 5, shuffle seed 42, fold 1 train/dev.
privacy: Author reports de-identification; automated pattern checks are not proof of zero PII. Keep raw text local.
limitations: Pre-declared unlabeled near-duplicate grouping fitted on all text including test; it is used only to construct conservative splits, never as model input representation.
Cosine threshold 0.95 detects only very similar surface forms, not all semantic or templated overlap.
Source dates, organizations, speakers, and language labels are not included; cannot establish chronological, client, or linguistic generalization.
Test includes exact duplicate source rows; report both row-weighted and unique-exact-group metrics.
No independent human validation of labels or anonymization was performed.
